# igpu-llm-bench

> Local LLM inference on an AMD UMA laptop APU (Ryzen AI 9 HX 375, Radeon 890M
> iGPU): measured decode and prefill throughput for Vulkan, ROCm and CPU, the
> memory carve-out commands, and the limits of each configuration.

This repository answers practical questions about running local language models
on unified-memory AMD laptop hardware. Every number is measured on one machine
and traced to a file in `data/`.

## Key facts

- Machine: AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 375, Radeon 890M (`gfx1150`), 32 GB LPDDR5X,
  Ubuntu, kernel 7.0.0-43.
- The VRAM carve-out is settable from Linux:
  `echo 7 | sudo tee /sys/class/drm/card*/device/uma/carveout` (index 7 = 16 GB)
  or `sudo amd-smi set -g 0 -m 7`. It survives reboot.
- 16 GB carve-out: 16,384 MiB VRAM, 7,638 MiB GTT, 15,277 MiB host RAM,
  24,022 MiB GPU-addressable.
- 0.5 GB carve-out: 512 MiB VRAM, 15,438 MiB GTT, 30,877 MiB host RAM.
- At short context the CPU was faster than the iGPU for every model tested:
  36.7 t/s vs 30.6 (ROCm) and 24.0 (Vulkan) on an 8.69 GiB mixture-of-experts
  model.
- Prefill is the opposite: 1,175 t/s on Vulkan vs 263 t/s on the CPU for the
  same model.
- A 17.25 GiB 35B MoE model runs at 24.19 t/s on Vulkan at the 16 GB carve-out
  (depth 0), 20.45 at 16K, 14.68 at 64K. ROCm cannot fully offload it at 16 GB.
- IQ4 quantization carries 2.15x fewer bytes per token than Q8 but is only
  1.41–1.92x faster, so effective bandwidth is lower for IQ4.
- MTP speculative decoding: 1.51x (95% CI 1.37–1.63). DFlash2: 1.28x
  (95% CI 1.00–1.56, marginal at n=9).

## Start here

- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): build llama.cpp, set the
  carve-out, choose a model, run a first benchmark.
- [FAQ](docs/faq.md): troubleshooting and how to read the numbers.
- [Models](docs/models.md): the exact Hugging Face repository, revision and
  licence for every model used.
- [Memory](docs/memory.md): RAM, VRAM carve-out, GTT and shared memory, with
  the arithmetic and the measured states.
- [Hardware](docs/hardware.md): the carve-out, GTT, heaps, model architecture.
- [Limitations](docs/limitations.md): what the measurements do not establish.
- [Results](RESULTS.md): every table with its source file.

## Data and code

- [Roofline analysis](analysis/roofline.md): bandwidth model and five hypotheses.
- [Backend comparison](docs/related/backend-comparison-512mb.md): Vulkan vs ROCm
  vs CPU at one carve-out, with shuffled rounds.
- [Carve-out scripts](scripts/carveout.sh): inspect and set VRAM and GTT.
- [Campaign runner](scripts/campaign.py): reproducible matrix with thermals.
- [Verifier](scripts/verify_results.py): fails if the prose disagrees with data.
- [Disclaimer](DISCLAIMER.md): scope, firmware risk, no warranty.

## Caveats

- One machine, one iGPU, one software stack (ROCm 10.0.0, llama.cpp
  `f872b5911`).
- The 35B measurements use the MTP variant (17.25 GiB); the archived 16.79 GiB
  file is not present.
- The carve-out comparison is thermally confounded (GPU reached 99 °C).
- Not a supported product. Measurements are provided as-is with their limits.
